outgoing.name: Cape Town
outgoing.excerpt: Its stronghold was Cape Province, in the area around Cape Town.

outgoing.name: Extinction
outgoing.excerpt: The Cape Lion Panthera leo melanochaitus is an extinct subspecies of lion.

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: In 2000, possible specimens were found in captivity in Russia and brought to South Africa for breeding.

outgoing.name: South Africa
outgoing.excerpt: The Cape Lion was not the only subspecies living in South Africa, and its exact range is unclear.
